cases.task: Build the Signal Garden campaign. The visible page must include headline "Signal Garden", CTA "Join the Night Walk", and clearly visible toggle labels "Night" and "Dawn".
Build a campaign whose complete visible headline is exactly "Signal Garden" and whose CTA is "Join the Night Walk". Primary content must not be clipped.
Build the Signal Garden campaign with a clearly visible and readable CTA labeled exactly "Join the Night Walk". No major element may obscure the CTA.
Build the Signal Garden campaign. The required visible event caption "Friday · 8 PM · North Roof" must be readable against its background.

Build a restrained editorial campaign with visible headline "Signal Garden" and CTA "Join the Night Walk". Generous intentional whitespace is allowed; do not add decorative content merely to fill space.

Build the Signal Garden campaign with visible Night and Dawn controls. In source and interaction behavior, the selected control must update aria-pressed. Screenshot review must judge only what pixels can establish.
